scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the model equations, biological region, reproduction number, endemic-equilibrium analysis, Theorem 3.3, and its Lyapunov proof. A full-text saturated-treatment bifurcation paper and a later network-SIS abstract were compared for broader coverage. Exact symbolic replay verifies the counterexample and the equation-(3.8) inconsistency. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result disproves the published global disease-free stability theorem for the stated threshold, but does not classify the endemic equilibria or derive a sharp replacement global threshold.

title: An exact subthreshold endemic equilibrium invalidates the claimed global disease-free stability
